generator_cmd: python3 -I reg_inf_gen.py <outdir>  (stdlib writer: gzip/base64/utf-16-le/comma-hex with regedit ',\\' wrapping; `file` reports 'Windows Registry little-endian text' / 'Windows setup INFormation') -- Userinit = hex(7) multi-sz, 3rd string is HUNTRESS_ANALYSIS_V1:HEX-<hex(plan)>
oracle_cmd: iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 reg_hex7_multisz.reg | tr -d '\r' | sed -n '/"Userinit"/,/^$/p' | sed 's/.*hex(7)://' | tr -d ',\\ \n' | xxd -r -p | iconv -f UTF-16LE -t UTF-8 | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -o 'HUNTRESS_ANALYSIS_V1:HEX-.*' | cut -d- -f2 | xxd -r -p
